guardrails: Avoid sharp corners; every container and the main frame must use high-radius rounding.
Do not use pure black text; stick to deep navy for high-contrast elements.
Avoid flat color backgrounds; use subtle gradients and light-refraction effects.
Don't overcrowd the layout; maintain significant white space around the copy block.

typography.mono: Space Mono, monospace (small caps) for utility labels

design.motion: Subtle vertical floating (bobbing) on the 3D blue tile centerpiece. Soft fade-in reveal for the text block, and a low-frequency shimmer effect across the glass tile grid.
design.centerpiece: A high-gloss 3D isometric blue tile floating above a grid of semi-transparent, frosted glass tiles.
design.layout: A wide-frame hero section with a top-left-heavy typography cluster balanced by a right-aligned 3D graphic. A floating navigation pill is centered at the bottom of the hero, while a separate logo marquee sits underneath in rounded capsules.
design.mood: Pristine, futuristic, and professional with a soft-tech aesthetic driven by skeuomorphic glass textures.
